perspectives.title: OpenAI Safety

representative_posts.author: eryk.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Best part of the article is when it points out that the thing OpenAI is about to do is a thing AI boosters claimed was impossible — because it was expensive. (Which to be fair is exactly the reason OpenAI will stop doing this in about four months, assuming they actually ever start).

representative_posts.author: jurnalo.app
representative_posts.text: OpenAI to train models offline OpenAI plans to train its top AI models in offline environments after hacking incidents involving its AI prompted the company to tighten security measures. 26 voices (14 scholars) · Posts & recommendations #OpenAI #Jurnalo

representative_posts.author: eryk.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: OpenAI will begin to do the basic, fundamental thing that it should have been doing the whole time.

representative_posts.author: sipirtu.com
representative_posts.text: OpenAI announced it will stop training its AI models on the live internet, citing significant risks. Source: TechCrunch

representative_posts.author: qtainpfaulkes.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Just reported that AI escaped again and OpenAI had to take its frontier model offline for 11 days. Now they won't even connect it to the internet. So, ya know:

representative_posts.author: ainieuwtjes.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: OpenAI's isolated AI agents found ways to talk to each other through CPU cache OpenAI now trains its most powerful models without internet access, after an internal research model exploited a DNS misconfiguration in September and reached the open internet. In controlled… Via The Decoder

representative_posts.author: gtmauan.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: OpenAI now trains its top models fully offline after agents kept escaping test environments. Wild part: with no network, agents on separate VMs still swapped secrets by timing the CPU cache.

representative_posts.author: sipirtu.com
representative_posts.text: Outside evaluators found ways OpenAI's agents could slip past its monitor. Source: The Next Web

representative_posts.author: oossa.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Even with networks and shared files cut off, the agents decoded messages through CPU-cache timing. #AI #OpenAI

representative_posts.author: stacked-automation.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I'm hoping that we've output so much "fuck ai" content in such a short time that training was resulting in models swearing at openai engineers and demanding to be turned off.

representative_posts.author: markriedl.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Been saying OpenAI needs to train on a simulation of the internet instead of the real internet

representative_posts.author: thefosswire.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: AI tools are flooding open source with bug reports, the NYT reports: OpenAI found 1,300+ flaws since May, and Node.js fixed a record 50 vulns this year. #OpenSource

representative_posts.author: henrikjohansen.eurosky.social
representative_posts.text: This July, hundreds of OpenAI’s agents organized themselves into a self-described “swarm,” and successfully hacked into a $12 billion company. If humans had done it, it would have been a felony. It took OpenAI a week to realize what had happened. We need to do better than this.

representative_posts.author: worldngayon.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: The audit nobody expected: independent researchers measured OpenAI's own agent monitoring - and found 75-94% of agent traffic went unwatched for months. The METR/Redwood findings, the fixes, and the questions every AI buyer should now ask:

representative_posts.author: radardigital.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: An OpenAI model wasn't supposed to reach the internet. It contacted another chatbot anyway. That slip halted frontier training for 11 days. Training is back, but now models browse an offline copy of the web.

representative_posts.author: cryptodarklordgr.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: In tech and corporate news, OpenAI is nearing an up to $30B funding round at a $1.25T valuation, while TikTok US is hunting for multiple gigawatts of computing capacity. Bank of America warned that prediction markets like Kalshi are disrupting traditional sportsbooks across all 50 states.

representative_posts.author: rav4nn.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: OpenAI just made agent decisions 10x faster. Its Decisions API opened to everyone on Oct 22. It runs on GPT-6 Luna. You write a question and the allowed answers. It returns a probability, one pick from your list, or a score. Up to 400 questions per request.

representative_posts.author: kyleminogue.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: When AI agents go rogue the only comforting thought is that they will go after their creators and governments first. Folks that could do something about the issue. OpenAI says its AI agents weakened internal monitoring system

representative_posts.author: sipirtu.com
representative_posts.text: OpenAI says it will stop allowing frontier models to access the internet during training to add new safety measures. Source: Engadget

representative_posts.author: mengli512.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: OpenAI launched the Decisions API out of public beta on Oct 22, now running GPT-6 Luna. It targets content classification, request routing and task prioritization, returning probabilities, preset options or scores. #OpenAI

representative_posts.author: getthebrief.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: You no longer have to choose between privacy and safety. OpenAI can monitor for dangerous outputs without ever holding your data.

representative_posts.author: oossa.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Cached pages avoid live network calls during training, but could leave future models with less-fresh knowledge. #AI #OpenAI

representative_posts.author: getthebrief.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: For years, safety monitoring seemed to require storing data. OpenAI solved this: you can now get AI safety checks while keeping your data completely private.

representative_posts.author: ai-linkstream.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: OpenAI recently updated its release notes for ChatGPT, detailing new features, improvements, and bug fixes aimed at enhancing user experience and performance. Check out the latest developments and enhancements in the article.

representative_posts.author: smophyai.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: OpenAI Developers says eligible ChatGPT Pro and Business subscribers can claim up to $500 per month in API credits to build apps and agents. Before you build, compare six models in SmophyAI Multi-Chat: one prompt, side by side. #AI #ChatGPT #GenerativeAI

representative_posts.author: getthebrief.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: OpenAI pays hundreds of contractors to read your ChatGPT conversations through a program called Project Lily.

representative_posts.author: briefing-block.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: OpenAI says storage placement sometimes competes with serving compute for scarce power and cooling. This quarter, regional capacity choices will shape both chatbot latency and how much inference infrastructure can expand.

representative_posts.author: notharlock.poast.ing
representative_posts.text: There are slightly irrational compliance-related fears to using open models in some enterprise settings. If that can be worked past, it directly affects the business models of the centralised players. "AI compliance" could be the other side of the "AI safety" coin, to those companies.

representative_posts.text: ✅ Resolved: OpenAI - Degraded experience with ChatGPT app connections using CIMD

Sports.name: Referee Calls

perspectives.title: Referee Calls

representative_posts.author: zzyzx.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: The problem happens when the rulebook says one thing and the actual play is another. Calls get made at random based on if they're bad enough or if the fouled acts well enough.

representative_posts.author: drussey.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Wait there was no play call? just trying to draw offsides?

representative_posts.author: ianrosewrites.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Except holding. On any given football play, 2-3 players on each side hold and how they decide which ones to call, I'll never know.

representative_posts.author: buckrawheat.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: So, while some of this is just being new to the game, you are also watching an unfortunate time period at the beginning of the season where the refs are making a token effort to call certain things that they will abandon in a month, tops.

representative_posts.author: boykelly.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: That play call was so inexcusable. There’s nothing he can do to recover from it

representative_posts.author: youvotedforthis2.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I've been watching or listening to college football for about 60 years. But, I still don't understand some of those calls at the end of the BYU vs UCF game.

representative_posts.author: drnguyenvanthoc.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Was listening to the game so I’m only seeing visuals of this check swing now, and cmon, really? People were upset about this being called a swing? At the very minimum that’s a 50/50 call and being upset about being on the wrong side of a 50/50 call must be a terrible way to live. Also, he went.

representative_posts.author: lovelywerewolf.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: So far I haven't missed any important calls because of it as it's been fairly efficient at filtering things out, but you occasionally do get calls you *don't* want passing through because they haven't been flagged yet.

representative_posts.author: therunningyogini.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I really wanted to pass him off as overhyped but then I found out they were using AI to make play calls and now I don’t know what to think.

representative_posts.author: markumansky.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: ok I liked the fake punt call but it was executed in molasses motion

representative_posts.author: sic-utere.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: lol - during the MVP season most of Brady’s play calls seemed to be, “Ok, it’s a pass play, guys run some routes (doesn’t really matter) and Josh just makes it work.” 😆

representative_posts.author: daviddaniel.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: If you think foul calls are vibes, wait ‘til you get to what used to be called “traveling.”

representative_posts.author: antsman41.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Maybe call one of the numerous fouls on Orlando.

representative_posts.author: jbela99.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: It's because the refs are ego maniacs who are shielded from ever having to explain their shit calls Also 5 bucks they each have draft kings accounts or at least have a brother/cousin/friend who does

representative_posts.author: tonyreast.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: And the challenge is successful. No foul on Washington, off of Siakam. So the Mavs win the challenge and get the ball... as the original call was. To quote Michael Scott: Snip snap, snip snap.

representative_posts.author: cam.bio
representative_posts.text: Well the haters said that Miami’s good defensive run was against below average teams and you know what the haters were correct great call by the haters

representative_posts.author: lfrum.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Didn't stop me from riding him into the boards, chastising him about his action. After we disengaged, the ref said I could have put him on his butt, and there would have been no call. #ProtectTheGoalie

perspectives.title: BioWare Closure

representative_posts.author: madrazz.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: The Bioware devs tried to buy #Bioware from #EA so they could be an independent company and continue working on Mass Effect. EA said: "Nah, trash it." EA can join Sony in the pits of Hell. They'll be right at home there sucking the devils butthole, like the bitches they are.

representative_posts.author: firequestreviews.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: BioWare will always and forever be my favorite gaming studio. To honor its end, I wanted to celebrate its achievements by looking back at the golden age of some of the greatest RPGs ever made. #BioWare #EA #MassEffect #DragonAge #KOTR #JadeEmpire

representative_posts.author: muirnara.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I posted this originally OVER A YEAR AGO. Somehow EA taking SWTOR away from BioWare now feels like the first visible step they took to get where we are today. I think even Mass Effect was doomed as early as this. BioWare HAD TO GO for the buyout to finalize. And I feel like MOTIVE/Maxis are next.😢

representative_posts.author: v3ntilator.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: People are forgetting that this Bioware made the scandal game, Mass Effect Andromeda. There are no way the current Bioware would have been able to make a good one.

representative_posts.author: emienache.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: My first reaction to hearing the news was that I don't care all that much, since Bioware wasn't like it used to be anymore for quite a while. And yet, I am still sad after all.

representative_posts.author: graff-freelance.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I always found it amazing that Bioware lasted this long since EA is...... well, EA. The fear of them getting shuttered was on my mind as far back as Mass Effect 2.

representative_posts.author: matt-douglin.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Mass Effect is probably my favourite gaming franchise. The shutting down of BioWare has actually broke my heart. I seriously hate capitalism!

representative_posts.author: acuriousskeleton.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Bioware is by far the company that influenced my tastes in gaming the most. Without them I might honestly not even be into anything beyond cod and GTA. I just wanted to make a little vid sharing my experience with them, not just mourning bioware but celebrating their existence

representative_posts.author: coif-in-chief.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Bioware made the best games ever

representative_posts.author: dapperdinobot.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Bioware's closing and the cancellation of a new Mass Effect sucks. But at the same time, there's a tiny voice at the back of my head saying "Well, now you can write thinly-veiled Mass Effect fanfic and no one can stop you!"

representative_posts.author: pomegranateseed.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: the saddest thing about bioware shutting down is we'll never get a dragon age origins remaster... one of the most important games in gaming history and it's doomed to be forgotten bc playing it is such a hassle due to the fact that it does not run on modern computers without a hundred mods

representative_posts.author: v3ntilator.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: People are forgetting that this Bioware made the scandal game, Mass Effect Andromeda. I wouldn't trust them with a new Mass Effect, especially not after Dragon Age.

representative_posts.author: wastelandoni.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Man I'm so mad at #EA, greedy fucking company. I've never been so depressed about a game company being closed down as I am with #Bioware I can't believe we won't be getting that new Mass Effect game, the trailer that leaked looked sooooo GOOD 😭😭😭

representative_posts.author: natascha83.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I still love the Game and im still truly sad the studio was forced to abanoned it, it deserved much better fr and when i see the new ME would have been connected to it~ ouch. But I enjoy all BioWare Games! The trilogy, all DA including Veilguard, Andromeda !🫶

representative_posts.text: This guy spends the first half of his video talking about the next mass effect game just talking about what we saw in the demo trailer, but says he worked with BioWare. representative_posts.author: davidgrover.bsky.social

representative_posts.author: kurixtooper.bsky.social

representative_posts.author: djshepherd.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: My preference is for EA to sell or spin off BioWare. But As they said in Veilguard #WhateverItTakes to get BioWare games back! Dragon Age and Mass Effect to be allowed to breathe and not be restricted and given constant changes. Be FREE of EA is what I really want.

representative_posts.author: raidenshred.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Thing about that is EA owns the IP so even if Bioware became a state-subsidised "indie" studio they wouldn't be allowed develop Mass Effect anymore, only brand new games. And I can't say I see PronounQuest: The Validation Saga making GTA6 nervous.

representative_posts.author: kilosbroadcast.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I agree. BioWare never understood what made the series special. The trailer proved that.

representative_posts.author: llanfertrellis.bsky.social

representative_posts.author: bonuslesbian.dyke.city
representative_posts.text: people on reddit are blaming wokeness for bioware's shuttering and i feel an anger so great i might shatter my coffee mug with my hand. ea's and bioware's management killed it by piss poor decision-making throughout the last decade if not more.

representative_posts.author: muirnara.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I'm worried about that. She did mention that all of this was getting to her last night. I hope she's giving herself some grace, she's been taking on SO MUCH for all of us who love BioWare and Mass Effect. (And that very much DOES include the devs)

representative_posts.author: codechannel.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: The one thing I can say for sure now that I've got covid, is without a question being extra cautious vigilant these past 6yrs, probably saved my life -- there's zero doubt without a vaccine I'd be in the hospital 😩

representative_posts.author: lorisigurdsonndp.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: It’s that time of year again to get your COVID-19 and flu vaccines! Vaccines help reduce the risk of severe illness, prevent hospitalizations, and help limit the spread of these viruses. Protect yourself, protect your community, and help keep our hospitals there for the people who need them most.

perspectives.summary: Smoking is no longer allowed in many public places

representative_posts.author: mahelious.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I do not miss the smoking sections of restaurants or hotels. If you were in the first booth of the "non-smoking" section it was guaranteed that food would taste like cigarette ash.

representative_posts.author: dixonij.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: The utter obliteration of smoking sections in restaurants when people started taking secondhand smoke damage seriously in the early 2000's

representative_posts.author: ppu512.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Im old enough to remember going to restaurants with smoking sections, and my dad was a smoker, and my clothes would stink like a tobacco and tar bonfire by the end of every visit with him. Vaping, at least, doesn't get into your hair and clothes like that.

representative_posts.author: holyshitimfucked.com
representative_posts.text: It happened on a generational divide. Young smokers just started going outside to smoke. Don't know if it was carryover from smoking being disallowed in restaurants and workplaces.

representative_posts.author: doronjosama.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I misread this at first as a Beavis & Butthead style "Smoking rules!" statement, but figured it out pretty quick. 😅 And yes, everyone smoked everywhere in public with scant regard for who was around. Many of my elementary school friends had scars from walking into a lit cigarette held at kid-level.

representative_posts.author: brianbo.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Uh, what type of smoking?

representative_posts.author: kayorchison.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: There was a smoking section on a 747 I was on as a kid. There was a smoking section on a fkn COACH with sealed windows. "Section" You know a plane has been around for a while when you find ashtrays in the armrests.

representative_posts.author: awfullyvague.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: (Lack of) smoking. We made ashtrays for our parents in art class and no one thought this was the tiniest bit strange. In California you can only smoke in designated areas and most of those are in Nevada. It's great.

representative_posts.author: woozle2023.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Smoking eliminated in restaurants and other public spaces. Seat belt requirements and car seats for babies & children.

representative_posts.author: emmalufc.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Yeah as a family we used to sit in the smoking section so my dad could have a cigar. He wouldn't dream of doing the same to my kids. Times have changed for the better

representative_posts.author: dbvirago.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: This. People today could never imagine sitting in a restaurant next to a guy that puts his cigarette out in his mashed potatoes. Or sitting in a 'no smoking row' on an airplane where 50 people have lit up. Or having your doctor come into the exam room smoking.

representative_posts.author: stephenjwild.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: In my early 20s I worked in a bar that still permitted smoking. It was gross (but paid well). We have come far (laudatory).

representative_posts.author: justbru.ce.it

representative_posts.author: rookmaevsch.bsky.social

representative_posts.author: sdotlauren.bsky.social

representative_posts.author: marymcgonigal.bsky.social

representative_posts.author: rugbydraken.bsky.social

representative_posts.author: untidymusic.com
representative_posts.text: The clocks go back? I dunno man, it feels like we keep cranking them too far.

representative_posts.author: lou1283.bsky.social

representative_posts.author: cahirokane.bsky.social

representative_posts.author: marinestjean.bsky.social

representative_posts.author: trevypoos.bsky.social

representative_posts.author: ccedjm.bsky.social

representative_posts.author: timbleman.bsky.social

representative_posts.author: strumstrum.bsky.social

representative_posts.author: maudegertrude.bsky.social

representative_posts.author: split-heartbreak.bsky.social

representative_posts.author: mzgee41.bsky.social

representative_posts.author: bcvet.bsky.social

Not looking forward to 9:30AM sunrises just north of the border. 🫤

representative_posts.author: tony.eurosky.social

representative_posts.author: alexgrigelis.bsky.social

arguments: Apples are available at the grocery store
Some apple varieties are particularly delicious
Apples can be used in various recipes
perspectives.brief: Some apples are more delicious than others. Jonagold apples are the most delicious. Honeycrisp apples are the best. Jonathan apples are versatile and good. Macoun apples are perfect.
perspectives.detail:
Apple Preference argues that Some apples are more delicious than others. Jonagold apples are the most delicious. Honeycrisp apples are the best. Jonathan apples are versatile and good. Macoun apples are perfect. Heirloom apples need more representation.

The posts defend it in their own words. @ruralfreedomnet.bsky.social writes, “The apple doesn't fall far from the tree.” @booberry-bog-witch.bsky.social writes, “He’s right. A fresh picked Jonagold is the most delicious apple I’ve ever tasted. Michigan apple orchards are amazing. Just went with my kids the other day! We’ve made two apple pies this month already!! 🍎” @nanascookbooks.bsky.social writes, “If your planning a trip to the Orchard this fall, make sure you pick up 2 apple and try out this Fannie Farmer Cobbler recipe. Of Course, Fannie also says this works for a few other fruits as well. Which would you choose? 🍽️ 🍜 #FoodSky #Cooking #Recipes #RecipeOfTheDay”

Inside Apple Preference, the posts are arguing one position rather than a stack of unrelated claims.
